responsibility: Checks explicit tail-call (`become`) expressions in typed bodies before MIR construction by walking THIR, validating that each tail call is a direct function call in an allowed context, and enforcing the caller/callee compatibility rules needed for tail-call lowering, including bans on closures and operator desugarings plus ABI, signature, `#[track_caller]`, and C-variadic constraints, while emitting targeted diagnostics and fix-it suggestions for invalid uses.
